text: Dr. Jee is probably the kindest, most empathetic and skilled dentist there is out there! I have visited this clinic in 2023 and now more recently again, and I am so happy to see that this place remains as professional and efficient as ever! The booking process is smooth and quick. They are so sweet to even accommodate requests that I am beyond grateful! I recommend you visit this clinic even if you don't live in this general area, simply because the kind doctor who speaks excellent English, will not only help you but also make you feel totally relaxed - your visit to the Dentist will NOT feel like a thing of dread! The reception staff are equally kind and helpful :)
